From: jimr9runner@aol.com <jimr9runner@aol.com>
Sent: Monday, December 2, 2019 3:53 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Possible Speaking Event 
 
By way of introduction, I am an acquaintance of your Aunt, Doris. We know Doris and Paul through my brother-in- law and his wife.
I was wondering if you would be willing to speak about the Tigers in front of the Men's Club of Grosse Pointe?
We meet for lunch on the second and fourth Tuesdays of each month at the Grosse Pointe War Memorial.
Please let me know and I will have the member in charge of speakers get in touch with you and make the arrangements.
